_comment: Pi-Bolt (github.com/opensec-git/Pi-Bolt) JIT builds fetched by scripts/fetch-pi-bolt.js into src-tauri/resources/pi-bolt/. version = bolt release (tag bolt-v*), piVersion = upstream Pi it was built from — must stay in sync with scripts/pi-version.json. sha256 values are taken from the release's SHA256SUMS asset (signature-verified by the installer, checksum-verified here).
